item.title: Indiana State Police Peru District Welcomes New Patrol K-9
item.description: On Wednesday, Dec. 10, the Indiana State Police held a ceremony at the Indianapolis District for the seven new ISP patrol K-9 handlers and their newly appointed K-9 partners who successfully completed the 16th Indiana State Police K-9 Training School.

item.title: Kosciusko County Jail Museum Gives Private Tour to DJ Daniel
item.description: The Kosciusko County Jail Museum welcomed DJ Daniel for a private tour, and gave him an honorary lifetime membership to the historical society.

item.title: Google’s $2B Fort Wayne Data Center Goes Live
item.description: On Thursday, Dec. 11, Google's $2 billion data center in Fort Wayne officially went live, marking one of the company’s largest recent infrastructure investments as it expands capacity for artificial intelligence and cloud services.

item.title: Two From Leesburg Facing Neglect Charges After Infant Overdoses At Residence
item.description: Two people from Leesburg are facing child neglect charges after an infant allegedly overdosed on drugs at their residence.

item.title: Combined Community Services’ Toy Time Event Meets 20,000 Toy Goal
item.description: Ami Pitt, Project Independence case manager and Hand-Up case manager, wanted to extend a heartfelt thank you to the community for helping Toy Time reach their 20,000-toy goal for these years Combined Community Services' Toy Time.

item.title: Turkey Creek Celebrates Scott’s Retirement At Syracuse Community Center
item.description: Community members and firefighters gathered 4 p.m. and will continue until 7 p.m. Friday, Dec. 12 at Syracuse Community Center, 1013 N Long Dr, Syracuse, to celebrate the retirement of longtime Turkey Creek Fire Territory Chief Mickey Scott, marking the end of a 36-year career in public service and the beginning of new leadership under incoming chief Quinn Hunter.
